name: BORU
description: Syntax highlighting and language-server support for BORU, a concatenative, strongly-typed query language.

config.title: BORU binary path
config.description: Path to the `boru` executable used to run the language server (`boru lsp`). Leave as `boru` to use the binary found on your $PATH, or give an absolute path (a leading ~ is expanded).

config.title: Enable language server
config.description: Start the `boru lsp` language server for diagnostics, hover, completion and formatting. Disable to use syntax highlighting only.
